features.name: Freehand drawing
steps: Press and drag on a blank canvas
Generate strokes continuously
Both fast and slow movements form continuous curves
Releasing ends the current stroke
Touching again creates a new independent stroke.
features.expected: Dragging must produce continuous strokes, and fast movement must not break the line or skip points; each stroke is recorded independently; releasing ends it immediately and touching again creates a new stroke rather than connecting to the old one.

features.name: Adjust the brush width
steps: Draw a line first
Drag the width slider at the bottom of the screen
Draw another line
New lines change width noticeably
Existing older lines keep their original width. The official documentation also explicitly supports different pen sizes. Simple Mobile Tools
features.expected: The slider must reflect the current brush width in both directions; new strokes use the new width; existing strokes' widths must not be retroactively modified; the width value is limited to the valid range.

features.name: Color selection and custom colors
steps: Tap the current color swatch
Open the color picker
Choose a preset color or pick a color from the 2D swatch/hue bar
Confirm
The current color swatch changes
Newly drawn content uses the new color. The official app supports both directly choosing a color and entering a hexadecimal color value. Simple Mobile Tools
features.expected: The selected color must immediately be reflected in the current-color indicator and new strokes use the new color; existing strokes keep their color; when hexadecimal input is supported, invalid values should be rejected or corrected.

features.name: Eyedropper
steps: Draw with at least two colors
Switch the color picker
Tap an existing color in the canvas
The current drawing color switches to the color of the tapped pixel
Draw another line to verify the color is consistent.
features.expected: Color picking must hit the real color of the tapped pixel rather than a preset approximation; after picking, the current-color indicator updates; the picking operation must not modify the canvas content.

features.name: Eraser
steps: Switch to the eraser over existing strokes
Drag across the strokes
The passed region is restored to the background/transparent state
After adjusting the width the eraser's affected area changes in sync
Then switch back to the drawing tool and continue drawing. The official documentation explicitly lists the eraser. Simple Mobile Tools
features.expected: The eraser must restore the passed region to the background or transparency rather than painting white; the affected area changes with the width; the erase result can be undone; drawing can continue normally after erasing.

features.name: Region fill
steps: Draw a closed region
Switch to the paint bucket
Choose a color
Tap inside the closed region
Only the region connected to the tap point is filled as a whole
Outside the boundary stays unchanged
When tapping an unclosed region, the fill range changes according to the connected region.
features.expected: The fill must apply to the connected region containing the tap point and must not cross closed boundaries; content outside the boundary stays unchanged; the fill color matches the selected color; an unclosed region must not crash or pollute the whole canvas.

features.name: Undo and redo
steps: Perform drawing, filling, and erasing several times in succession
Tap undo to step back through the operations
Each time only the state from before the last operation is restored
Then perform redo
Restore in the original order
When a new operation is performed after an undo, the unusable redo branch is cleared.
features.expected: Undo must step back through the operation history in reverse and only one step at a time; redo restores in the original order; when a new operation is performed after an undo the unusable redo branch must be cleared; it works consistently for drawing, filling, and erasing.

features.name: Change the canvas background color
steps: Several strokes of different colors already exist
Choose "change background color" from the menu
Set another background color
The canvas background changes immediately
The strokes' own colors are not redrawn
Subsequent erasing stays consistent with the current background. The official documentation also explicitly supports changing the background color. Simple Mobile Tools
features.expected: Changing the background color must not redraw or alter existing strokes; what is revealed after erasing must be the current background color; the background change can be undone; the background color is reflected in the output file when saving.

features.name: Open an existing image and continue editing
steps: Choose an existing PNG/JPG via "open file"
The image becomes the current canvas content
Drawing, erasing, or color picking can continue on top of it
After saving, a result containing the new edits is produced
Reopening the file shows the modified visual result. The official documentation states that existing artwork can be opened and drawing can continue. Simple Mobile Tools
features.expected: The opened image must become the current canvas content; drawing and erasing on it must be composited and saved with the image; reopening must show the modified result, not merely a blank or the original image.

features.name: Use an image as the drawing background
steps: Import an existing image as the canvas base
The image stays in the background layer
Add strokes on top of it
Change the drawing color, width, or erase the upper content
The background image is still preserved
It is composited into the final image on export. The official documentation lists "using an image ... as the background" as an official feature. Simple Mobile Tools
features.expected: The background image must be independent of the stroke layer, and modifying strokes or erasing must not damage the background; on export it must be composited into a final image that includes the background; the background layer can be replaced or removed.

features.name: Saving and multi-format export
steps: Finish the drawing
Tap save
Enter a file name
Choose a format among .png / .svg / .jpg
Confirm
The file is written to the device
PNG/JPG can be reopened as bitmaps and SVG is generated in the corresponding format. Both the screenshots and the official materials support these three formats. Simple Mobile Tools
features.expected: All three formats must be genuinely written to the device; PNG and JPG can be reopened as bitmaps; SVG must be generated as a vector format and correctly display the drawing content; the extension matches the actual format.

features.name: Save–open loop
steps: Create a drawing containing strokes of multiple colors and widths
Save as a file
Clear/exit the current screen
Reopen via "Open file"
The main visual content matches the pre-save state
Edit again
Save again
The file content changes accordingly.
features.expected: After saving and reopening, the drawing must be visually consistent with the pre-save state; after editing and saving again the file content changes accordingly; strokes must not be lost and a blank canvas must not be saved.

features.name: Share and print
steps: The completion screen
Tap share
The Android share sheet receives the current image file
The app canvas state is preserved on return; or choose print from the menu
The current drawing is passed to the system print flow as a printable image. The official materials also list share and print as features. Play Store Sales
features.expected: Sharing must provide the system with the real image file of the current canvas and the correct MIME type; cancelling the share leaves the canvas state unchanged; the print flow must receive the current drawing content rather than a blank or other image.
